name: plantuml-diagrams
title: PlantUML
description: Draw PlantUML diagrams in issues, comments and Knowledge Base articles. Insert a PlantUML block from the editor toolbar and type the diagram source. The diagram is rendered in your browser: the source is not sent to a server. C4 diagrams are supported. In projects that the app is attached to, a one-line panel can replace ```plantuml code blocks with diagrams and back. The app changes an issue or article only after a user turns this on for that item.
changeNotes:
Version 1.0.1

  • Change: The app now works with YouTrack 2026.2 and later

Version 1.0.0

  • Feature: PlantUML block in the editor (Images and embedded content → PlantUML) with a live preview
  • Feature: Diagrams are rendered in the browser; the diagram source is not sent to a server
  • Feature: C4-PlantUML library (!include <C4/...>)
  • Feature: Light and dark theme
  • Optional: in projects that the app is attached to, a one-line panel converts ```plantuml code blocks to diagrams and back. An issue or article changes only after a user selects Convert to diagrams for it
